limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.

justified_rtl_tb_changes.rtl: Initial implementation only: high-transparent latch for p and falling-edge register capturing p for q. No reset or initialization added.
justified_rtl_tb_changes.testbench: Original waveform replayed at its 5 ns timestamps, including simultaneous clock/input changes and initial unknown values; comparisons occur 1 ps after stimulus for event settling. Seven additional directed checks cover transparency, holding, and falling-edge capture. No testbench revisions.

interface_cycle_contract: TopModule(clock, a, p, q), all one bit; p follows a while clock is high and holds while low; q captures p on falling clock edges.
static_review: Intentional latch, single drivers, nonblocking sequential assignments, unchanged ports and no extra latency.
